name: TwistingData.hasType_twisted_hecke
summary: Factor the operator twice through exists_depth_factorization (once for the map e ↦ (src e, g e), once for the coset representatives), pair the factorisations with the projector of exists_projector, and apply of_pairing: this gives IndexDvd with exponent controlled by dimensions of excess and deep spaces over the residue field κ_O of O, which index_mul_finrank_excessCond_le and sum_finrank_deepForms_le bound (for S = T mod 𝔪, twisting data over κ_O; κ_O can differ from the residue field of W, which has q = P^N elements, and it has characteristic p because p is not a unit in O). Push the index statement through f∘ε to the image of f.

steps.claim: Unpack the needed parts of big (e: ℓ + ℓ = N; h1: the bound N·n·k(ℓ+2) + n + k < P^ℓ).
Let c = 2·(…) + 2, the constant of HeckeSizes.
Let S = T mod 𝔪, twisting data over the residue field.
steps.lean: let S := T.map (residue O)

steps.claim: (r − 1) + 1 = r for the indices r − 1, r ∈ Fin k.
steps.lean: have ha : @Fin.val k ⟨r - 1, by lia⟩ + 1 = @Fin.val k ⟨r, by lia⟩ := by lia
steps.typed_fact: @Fin.val k ⟨r - 1, by lia⟩ + 1 = @Fin.val k ⟨r, by lia⟩

steps.claim: w is not a unit (else p = w² would be, hp); the residue field κ_O of O (the field of S, not the residue field of W) has characteristic p, since p is not a unit in O (hp), so p lies in 𝔪 and its residue is 0; and some x bounds the depth of every family (finitely many).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨hu, _, x, hm⟩ := (T.w_sq ▸ hp) ∘ .pow 2, CharP.of_eq_zero S.prime
    ((residue_eq_zero_iff _).2 hp), Finite.exists_le (T.depth k n r)

steps.claim: Collect: U (index_mul_finrank_excessCond_le for S), U' (sum_finrank_deepForms_le for S at x), the projector (b, Z, hZ, hZ', hρ) of exists_projector with θ = y, and two depth factorisations over H × (X × GL_k(W)/𝒫): (Q, d, R, hj, h₀, hR, hQ) for s(h, e) = (h, src e) and the transposed matrices g(e)ᵀ = transposeGL(g e), whose inverse cosets (g(e)ᵀ)⁻¹𝒫 are those of hs (surjective after reassociation, as hs is an injective self-map of the finite set X × GL_k(W)/𝒫, hence a bijection); and (Q', d', R', j', h₁, hR', hQ') for the projection (h, (x, b)) ↦ (h, x) and the inverses b̃⁻¹ of the chosen coset representatives b̃ = b.out (surjective: (h, (x, b)) goes to ((h, x), b)). The transposes matter at the end, where the symmetry hρ of the projector (b(β)·ρ(γᵀ)_{βα} = b(α)·ρ(γ)_{αβ}) is used.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨U, U', ⟨b, Z, hZ, hZ', hρ⟩, ⟨Q, d, R, hj, h₀, hR, hQ⟩, Q', d', R', j', h₁, hR', hQ'⟩ :=
    S.index_mul_finrank_excessCond_le ha big, S.sum_finrank_deepForms_le big x, T.exists_projector c
    hp ha y e h1, T.exists_depth_factorization c ha.le hm _ _ ((prodAssoc H ..).symm.surjective.comp
    (surjective_id.prodMap hs.bijective_of_finite.2)), T.exists_depth_factorization c ha.le hm (.map
    id (·.1)) (·.2.2.out⁻¹) (⟨prodAssoc H X _ ·, by simp⟩)

steps.claim: Apply of_pairing with Q, M = (blockdiag(u.2) ⊗ Z)·R'ᵀ, R, β = Q'ᵀ·(blockdiag(u.1) ⊗ diag(b)), a = w^{…}, z = p^m, hR and hu: it gives l, L (|E| + l ≤ dimension) and key (IndexDvd ⊤ (image of β·Q + p^m·⊤) (a^{|E|}·p^{ml})).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨l, L, key⟩ := T.of_pairing Q (blockDiagonal (u · |>.2) ⊗ₖ Z * R'ᵀ) R
    (Q'ᵀ * blockDiagonal (u · |>.1) ⊗ₖ diagonal b) (T.w ^ _) (T.p ^ m) hR hu (fun i j ↦ by
    grw [← pow_succ, one_le_two]
    convert univ.dvd_sum fun y _ ↦ hZ' _ (hQ' (Pi.single i 1) y (by bound)) (R' j ⟨y, ·⟩)
    simp [← transpose_eq_one.2 hR', ← (_ ⊗ₖ _).mul_assoc, ← mul_kronecker_mul, w_sq,
      ← blockDiagonal_mul, mul_apply, diagonal, blockDiagonal_apply, one_apply, mul_assoc, pow_mul])
      fun v _ _ h x γ hγ β hβ e ↦ by simpa [← pow_succ, pow_dvd_pow_iff T.w_ne_zero hu, c, e,
      mem_span_singleton, Pi.smul_comp, -mulVec] using (Set.mem_of_eq_of_mem (congr($h
      ∘ (x, ·)).symm.trans (by
      rw [← mulVec_mulVec, ← (vec_bijective.2 (R'ᵀ *ᵥ _)).choose_spec, kronecker_mulVec_vec]; ext
      simp; rfl)) (sub_mem (hQ v x (by bound)) (hZ _)) γ hγ β hβ)

steps.claim: Its hypothesis h: a·w divides every entry of β·M − a·1, from the projector property hZ' applied to the columns of Q' (hQ'), with R'Q' = 1 (hR') and w² = p.
steps.lean:
(fun i j ↦ by
    grw [← pow_succ, one_le_two]
    convert univ.dvd_sum fun y _ ↦ hZ' _ (hQ' (Pi.single i 1) y (by bound)) (R' j ⟨y, ·⟩)
    simp [← transpose_eq_one.2 hR', ← (_ ⊗ₖ _).mul_assoc, ← mul_kronecker_mul, w_sq,
      ← blockDiagonal_mul, mul_apply, diagonal, blockDiagonal_apply, one_apply, mul_assoc, pow_mul])

steps.claim: Its hypothesis hn: if Q·v' − M·v = (a·w)·F, each block of F lies in translatesIn T n (twoBlock) 𝔪 {excess > …}: from hQ (the blocks of Q·v') and hZ (the image of Z), read through the Kronecker product.
steps.lean:
fun v _ _ h x γ hγ β hβ e ↦ by simpa [← pow_succ, pow_dvd_pow_iff T.w_ne_zero hu, c, e,
      mem_span_singleton, Pi.smul_comp, -mulVec] using (Set.mem_of_eq_of_mem (congr($h
      ∘ (x, ·)).symm.trans (by
      rw [← mulVec_mulVec, ← (vec_bijective.2 (R'ᵀ *ᵥ _)).choose_spec, kronecker_mulVec_vec]; ext
      simp; rfl)) (sub_mem (hQ v x (by bound)) (hZ _)) γ hγ β hβ)

steps.claim: Let ε be the linear equivalence of coefficient spaces (X × Fam) × H-indexed ↔ X → I → O given by J.
steps.lean:
let ε := .funCongrLeft O O ((((prodComm ..).trans (J.prodCongr (.refl X))).trans
    (prodAssoc ..)).trans (prodComm ..)) ≪≫ₗ .curry ..

steps.claim: Chain the index statements (IndexDvd.comp/of_det_dvd): from det d' (h₁), key and det d (h₀), IndexDvd for the full operator's image plus p^m·⊤, with exponent a product of powers of w and p.
steps.lean:
have := (IndexDvd.of_det_dvd (d'.det_transpose ▸ h₁) le_sup_left).comp le_top
    (key.comp le_top (.of_det_dvd h₀ le_sup_left))

steps.claim: Collect the exponent into one power of p (w² = p).
steps.lean: simp_rw [mul_left_comm, ← mul_pow, ← sq, pow_mul, w_sq, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add] at this

steps.claim: HasType: Y(range f) ⊆ range f by hY; for the index, the exponent bound (a goal) and IndexDvd pushed forward along f∘ε (IndexDvd.map), with an image inclusion (a goal).
steps.lean: refine ⟨by simp [hY], _, ?_, this.map (f ∘ₗ ε) (by simp) ?_⟩

steps.claim: Use c/2 ≤ y.
steps.lean: grw [← (by bound : c / 2 ≤ y)]

steps.claim: Simplify the cardinalities in L, U, U' and the goal.
steps.lean: simp [Subgroup.index, card_congr J, c, ← mul_sum] at L U U' ⊢; rify at L

steps.claim: The exponent bound is the linear combination m·L + |X|·|H|·(m·U + U') of the dimension bounds.
steps.lean: linear_combination (norm := linarith!) ↑m * L + card X * card H * (↑m * U + U')

steps.claim: Rewrite the images of compositions.
steps.lean: simp [← LinearMap.range_comp, -IsConcreteLE.le_iff]

steps.claim: Image inclusion: an element f(F) of the left side is Y applied to f(ε((b ·.2)·F)), up to the p^m part.
steps.lean: refine le_sup_of_le_left fun | _, ⟨F, rfl⟩ => ⟨ε ((b ·.2) * F), ?_⟩

steps.claim: Expand with hY and the factorisations hj, j'.
steps.lean: simp [hY]; erw [hj, j']; congr!

steps.claim: Unfold ε, the block diagonal and diagonal matrices.
steps.lean:
simp [ε, ← J.symm.sum_comp, @sum_prod_type_right _ _ H, ← mulVec_mulVec, sq,
    mul_apply, blockDiagonal, diagonal, ← w_sq, mul_pow, ite_and]

steps.claim: Conclude with the symmetry hρ of the projector.
steps.lean: congr!; rw [sum_comm_cycle]; clear * - hρ; grind
